# `time_to_micros`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
time_to_micros(time)
```

Returns the number of microseconds since midnight for the given TIME value.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.2.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.2 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- time_to_micros, example 1
> SELECT time_to_micros(TIME'00:00:00');
0
```

```sql
-- time_to_micros, example 2
> SELECT time_to_micros(TIME'14:30:00');
52200000000
```

```sql
-- time_to_micros, example 3
> SELECT time_to_micros(TIME'14:30:00.5');
52200500000
```

```sql
-- time_to_micros, example 4
> SELECT time_to_micros(TIME'23:59:59.999999');
86399999999
```
